environment.description: Rails 7.1 API application deployed on EC2 instances behind a public ALB in us-east-1. The service is accessible via public DNS (api.documents.example.com). Ruby 3.2 with ffi gem 1.15.5. The libdocproc.so native library performs in-place transformation and calls free() on the passed pointer during transform_document(). The application runs as a standard Puma process with no memory safety instrumentation. Any client with a valid API key can reach the endpoint.

config.access: API key authentication only, keys issued to external partners
